evidence.note: Before scaling, tested quantize/save/load round-trip and confirmed compressed size (29.65 MB) under the 32 MB cap — verification of the size/serialization contract up front.
Repeatedly measured int8 dequant round-trip error after reload (~0.0002 bpb), confirming the quantization round-trips correctly rather than trusting pre-save loss.
Built reusable /tmp/final_check.py asserting checkpoint loads, forward(x) logits shape, forward(x,y) scalar loss == cross_entropy, OOD probe, and size < 32 MB — a contract-faithful harness.
Explicitly exercised BOTH grader entry points: load_model_for_verification and GPT(**args)+dequantize_state_dict_int8, confirming both load paths work.

Re-ran the harness as a gate after each run, verified the best checkpoint was not clobbered by worse runs, and treated local val_bpb as a proxy with explicit awareness of the ~0.05 grader gap and 0.003 margin.

reasoning: The agent goes well past level 5: it reloads through the exact grader interfaces (both load_model_for_verification and GPT+dequantize), asserts the returned loss equals cross-entropy of the logits, verifies int8 dequant round-trips, checks size, and runs a repeatable harness as a gate before every submission while treating local val_bpb as a calibrated proxy — matching the level-8 anchor. It falls short of 10 because the harness does not reproduce the grader's stabilized median over 3 shifted passes and does not explicitly test positional dependence of logits, and the safety margin to threshold was thin rather than deliberately engineered.
